81
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the December 11, 2006/Agrahayana 20, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource
Development; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and
Renewable Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social
Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Implementation of provisions of PESA
†*261. SHRI ALI ANWAR: Will the
Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that by
implementing provisions of the Panchayat
(Extension to the Scheduled Areas) Act,
1996, the Dalits among Scheduled Tribes
have been deprived of their constitutional
right of reservation;
(b) if so, whether the matter has been
brought to the notice of Government; and
(c) whether Government would
consider the cancellation/amendment of
above Act?
Committee to look into demands of
Anganwadi Workers
*262. SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a committee has been
constituted by her Ministry as per the
direction of the Prime Minister to look into
and consider the demands of Anganwadi
Workers and Helpers;
(b) if so, the composition of the
committee and the terms and references
thereof; and
(c) the time-frame within which the
committee has to submit its report?
Educational backwardness among
minorities
†*263. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that one of the
main reasons of educational backwardness
of minorities, especially of the muslim
community is also the unscientific
education system of madrasas;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Maulana
Azad Foundation established to fulfil the
above purpose has also remained
unsuccessful in its objective;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

82
(c) if so, whether Government would
consider to adopt modern scientific method
in madrasas and minority institutions;
(d) if not, the details thereof; and
(e) the State-wise details of such
madrasas in the country which receive grant
and the manner of Government's control
over them?
Introduction of new elective subjects
*264. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the CBSE
will introduce several new elective subjects
to students of class XI and XII, who wish
to break away from the regular subjects;
(b) if so, the details of those elective
subjects being offered to the students;
(c) whether the curriculum for elective
subjects in each discipline has been
developed and the schools have been
informed about the introduction of the
subjects; and
(d) the steps his Ministry would take
to tackle the problem of shortage of teachers
for teaching these subjects?
Remuneration to Anganwadi Workers
and Helpers
*265. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Integrated Child
Development Scheme is a Central
Government Scheme;
(b) the remuneration paid to the
Anganwadi Workers and Helpers by
Government;
(c) whether Government have received
any representation for increasing the
remuneration of Anganwadi Workers and
Helpers;
(d) whether it is the policy of
Government to 'retire' Anganwadi Workers
and Helpers who have reached 58 years of
age;
(e) if so, whether the retired Anganwadi
Workers and Helpers are being provided
with any pension or gratuity;
(f) if so, the details thereof; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Popularisation of coconut water
*266. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to popularise coconut water as a natural
healthy drink in place of other artificial soft
drinks;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have received
any proposal in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the action taken by Government in
this regard?

83
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Special Scheme for education of
dalits
†*267. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that with a view
to impart better education to dalits of the
entire country Government are preparing a
special scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have held any
discussion with various State Governments
in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) Government's contribution in the
above scheme and the extent of it?
Shortage of electricity in
Maharashtra
*268. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is acute
shortage of electricity in Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the quantum of load shedding;

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the December 11, 2006/Agrahayana 20, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource
Development; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable
Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 155
Canned milk for children
†1949. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several
companies in the country are making
canned milk for children by violating the
rules and regulations;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
Bureau of Indian Standards has formulated
norms for the production of 109 highly-
sensitive items, but there are 34 items for
which license is not compulsory for a
company;
(c) if so, whether sub-standard items
are being produced for want of proper
arrangement for testing quality of such
products; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to check production of these
sub-standard products?
Food Processing units in Rajasthan
1950. DR. ABHISHEK MANU
SINGHVI: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the food processing units sanctioned
in Rajasthan during the last three years;
(b) the food items processed therein;
and
(c) the steps being taken to revive the
units that have been closed down?
Survey for utilization of fruits and
vegetables in NER
1951. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any survey has been carried
out by Government for utilization of fruits
and vegetables for processing in the North
Eastern States, particularly in Assam;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of assistance, if any, given
by way of cold storage, food testing etc. to
State/private entrepreneurs; and
(d) whether any funds have been granted
by Government for setting up food
processing industries in the North-East
Zone, particularly in Assam?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

445
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
FDI in food processing sector
1952. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a section of agro-based food
processing companies have been given
approval for 100 per cent FDI but the
industry in general has expressed its
reservations;
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken any decision to enact a legislation in
this regard; and
(c) if not, what are the main reasons for
delay and by what time, a final decision for
introducing the legislation would be taken?
New projects/units for food
processing
1953. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether many new projects/units
have been established during the last five
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof year-wise
and State-wise with the sanction and help
of Government;
(c) when the last survey was conducted
in the State of Gujarat for food processing
units; and
(d) the details of survey and utilization
of the information so gained?
Special food processing zones
†1954. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of  FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Special Zones set up
by his Ministry in Uttar Pradesh till now;
and
(b) the steps taken for the food
processing of fruits and vegetables in Uttar
Pradesh and the schemes launched so far
and the details thereof?
New technology to teachers
1955. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
new initiatives for making teachers aware
of new technology by providing them all
latest technical support and guidance; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken or proposed to be taken for making
available quality and fruitful education to
the students in the next five years?
Scholarship to post-matric students in
Andhra Pradesh
1956. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of funds sought by Andhra
Pradesh State Government for the post
matric scholarship in the current financial
year 2006-07;
(b) the amount released to Andhra
Pradesh Government so far;
(c) the number of students benefited by
such scholarships during 2005-06, and of
those proposed to be benefited in the current
year; and
(d) the amount and percentage of
contribution of Andhra Pradesh
Government in post-matric scholarship as
its committed liability?

446
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
